aggregate_extension.rule: Use the existing canonical Book aggregate and Version/Rollback transaction boundary. Do not create a second canonical store or lifecycle authority.
aggregate_extension.history_semantics: append-only stable CHAPTER/SCENE version identities; active chapter/scene order is materialized only through a newly versioned BOOK_PLAN so existing Version/Rollback remains the active canonical selection authority

operations.REGISTER_CONTENT_OBJECT_VERSION: append exactly one immutable successor version for an existing parent-governed object family with exact digest, provenance, source subject and predecessor binding
operations.REGISTER_CONTENT_UNIT_VERSION: append exactly one immutable CHAPTER or SCENE version with stable unit identity, same-book parentage, deterministic ordinal, exact digest, provenance and predecessor binding
operations.SET_ACTIVE_CONTENT_OBJECT_VERSION: move an existing canonical object pointer only under PARENT_SYSTEM authority and preserve governing-brief/canon project pointer mirrors
operations.SET_ACTIVE_CONTENT_UNIT_ORDER: bind deterministic CHAPTER/SCENE refs into a newly registered BOOK_PLAN version; this operation does not create a second active-order store

transaction_rules: expected_state_version and expected_state_digest must match before mutation
all operations commit atomically through one Version/Rollback successor transaction
same mutation_id plus byte-identical request replays the prior receipt
same mutation_id with divergent request content fails closed
one mutation may create at most one new version in a given object or unit family
provider/child classes cannot commit canonical admission
stale or missing provenance fails closed
a required author decision must already exist as approved evidence; the runtime never fabricates one
project lifecycle status, export freeze and publication authority are outside this contract
chapter_scene_rules: SCENE parent_object_ref is an exact CHAPTER:<stable_unit_id>:<version_id> in the same Book project
unit predecessor lineage is linear and immutable
active unit ordering must be strictly deterministic by ordinal and may reference only exact registered unit versions
a scene in active order must have its exact parent chapter in the active chapter order

qualification_requirement.hosted: Run the deterministic qualifier plus the existing 48-case Version/Rollback qualifier on the exact final wrapper-bearing SHA.
qualification_requirement.a01: Hosted PASS may only prepare later A-01 admission. It is never A-01 PASS.
